name: lullu
description: Prompt protocols and single-file HTML output skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: mantra-protocol
plugins.description: Self-enforcing prompt protocol. Pins non-negotiable principles to a mantra the agent recites before every turn, so specification fidelity survives long sessions.

plugins.name: relay-ko
plugins.description: Write Korean prose by relay — draft in Japanese and Turkish first, then translate — so blank-page generation cannot fall back to AI-flavored Korean.

plugins.name: review-doc
plugins.description: Turn any content into a single self-contained HTML review file with per-item approve/reject toggles and comment boxes. Autosaves to localStorage, copies verdicts as Markdown.

plugins.name: htmlkit
plugins.description: Build single-file HTML decks, narrative reports, and ADRs by composing structure (format) and design (look) independently.

plugins.name: schematic
plugins.description: Draw system logic, architecture, and product strategy as Bold-Outline Flat single-file HTML schematics — swimlanes, flowcharts, sequences, matrices.

plugins.name: interview-doc
plugins.description: Turn an interview transcript in any language into a single annotated HTML report with per-passage commentary and per-chapter synthesis.
